svg.text: HostelCare Complaint Maintenance Lifecycle and State Transitions
Verified against admin_service.py, staff_service.py & student_service.py (complaints.status CHECK)
Legend & Database Side-Effects: Solid Arrow = Primary Forward Transition | Dashed Arrow = Alternate / Admin Exception Path
• Every transition appends complaint_history & audit_logs, triggers notifications, and updates complaints.version. Photos allowed before closed/rejected.
